description: Zentrale KidMotion Bildwelt. Google Flow erzeugt alle sichtbaren Texte im Bild. Remotion darf ausschliesslich den numerischen Countdown-Timer ueber das statische Bild legen.
rules: 16:9 landscape, premium stylized 3D kids animation look
exactly one recurring KidMotion child per episode
child identity follows characters/CHARACTER_BIBLE.md
same face, hair, age appearance, skin tone and body proportions throughout one episode
episode outfit and world are locked after Bild 01 approval
full body must remain readable for all exercise poses
exercise pose must be understandable from one still image
bright clean child-friendly lighting and uncluttered composition
generic original sports environments only; no real team, league, sponsor or brand logos
Bild 01 is the primary character/world reference for Bild 02 through the outro
Bild 04 is the secondary exercise title/instruction UI reference for later exercise images
ALL visible text except the changing countdown number is generated directly by Google Flow inside the source image
Bild 01 contains the complete Intro text
Bild 02 contains the complete Safety text
Bild 03 contains LET'S BEGIN!
Bild 04 through Bild 15 contain exercise title bottom-left plus instruction top-right
Bild 16 contains GREAT JOB! and WORKOUT COMPLETE
top-left 220x220 px remains clear on exercise images for the Remotion timer
there is no Remotion progress bar and therefore no bottom progress-bar safe zone
Rest reuses the next exercise image and Remotion adds only the countdown timer; no REST label is added
forbidden: cropped hands, feet or important joints
